## Findings and reproduction

1. **Chart horizontal selection / tooltip (#2967).** In QA Native → Settings → activity detail → 7 days, tap the Tuesday Token bar: AX reports the full `二, 28.8K tokens` but the visible callout reads `28.8K toke…`. Pan from x=278 to x=58 at y=345 over 1.6 seconds in the unchanged 375 × 812 phone viewport: recorded touch path moves left while the selected Tuesday callout stays unchanged, clearing after release. Earlier left-to-right pan also produced no tooltip. Native timed-gesture receipts and both original recordings are retained privately; the reverse recording is published. No root-cause claim from a failed drive.
2. **Title Case gaps (#2961).** Switch Language to English and open Appearance; current choice list contains “Follow system”. Other mixed-case controls remain in Settings. See `p-menu-l.png`, `p-set-l.png`, `s-set-d.png`.
3. **Direct Computer entry / physical Host long-press need follow-up.** Native ref press of `profile-computer` on both devices reported a tap but left the profile visible. Physical QA Host long-press likewise did not open a menu. Their original evidence is retained; these direct paths are not qualified. A later coordinate press closed the phone profile successfully. A correctly registered `deepseekbot-dev://computer/<qa-bot>?hostId=<qa-host>` link opened live Computer; take control and hand back worked. Alternate paths are recorded separately, not used to override first failures.
4. **Cleanup warning.** Phone Unpair displayed an unreachable-Host warning after removing the local entry; authenticated Host `devices` nevertheless confirmed its exact device ID revoked. Both temporary IDs were revoked and original pairings remained. This is an additional observed warning, not proof of residual access.

## Resource release

Both temporary device pairings were removed; both exact Host device IDs have `revokedAt`. Original phone two / Simulator three pairings remain. Language/appearance returned to System, Simulator system light and `large` restored, VoiceOver off, original haptic and delivery settings retained. Installed Dev apps and existing data remain; TestFlight untouched.

Owned Browser, Computer, LAN, Host, Metro, fixture server and native drivers stopped; owned ports released. Simulator returned to Shutdown. Protected shared services unchanged. The closed isolated QA Profile and fixture data are retained for reproduction; no Bot deletion or user-data cleanup was attempted. Native resource **RELEASED** does not mean product or release acceptance. Follow-up fixes and another native window are required for failed/unverified cases.
